name: vibeset
description: Agent skills from Vibeset: instructions you hand your coding agent once and it knows for good.

plugins.name: finito
plugins.description: Closes a working session with a summary you can read, a handoff block for compacting now and a resume block for coming back another day.

plugins.name: diretto
plugins.description: Forces the agent to answer in numbered steps you can execute: a one-sentence verdict, the exact commands, what only you can do now kept apart from what can wait, and a separate list of what is missing.

plugins.name: smart-defaults
plugins.description: Makes a website start in the visitor's own theme and language, with no flash and no forced redirects.

plugins.name: spanish-cave-man
plugins.description: Caveman-style token efficiency, spoken with a real Spanish regional accent: eleven dialects, two intensity levels.

plugins.name: siteindex
plugins.description: Gets a website found and ranked: starts by auditing what you already have, then robots.txt, sitemap, canonical, Open Graph, JSON-LD, the AI-crawler decision, search intent, internal links, speed and local, ending in a measurement.

plugins.name: galsas
plugins.description: Audits a repository for legal exposure (AI Act marking, dependency licences, GDPR and cookies, consumer sales) and writes a LEGAL.md with the fix for each finding.

plugins.name: criteria
plugins.description: Turns several loose questions into a one-file HTML questionnaire, one question per screen with word-and-sentence tiles, a progress bar, real multi-select checkboxes, a mandatory "Other" option, and a button that copies every answer as one block of text to paste back into the chat.

plugins.name: gresso
plugins.description: A live progress page for long agent tasks: a one-file HTML with a progress bar, percentage, what is done, what is left and what is blocked, rewritten by the agent as it works. The open tab updates by itself, and what the person has to do or decide lives on the same page.
